headline: 72% of ADIB's written reviews give five stars and 19% give one or two. The complaints that recur are release loops, face verification on a new phone and the move from SMS to push notifications.
lede: ADIB answers 64% of written reviews, with a median gap of under a day. The best month with at least 100 reviews is 2020-09 (average 4.76); 83% of that month's reviews are under 40 characters, so volume rose faster than detail. 87 reviews since 2023 mention the selfie or face scan.
method: Averages here are of written reviews only. Store ratings (4.69 App Store, 4.63 Google Play) include star-only ratings, which are not public and skew positive. Sentiment comes from the star rating (1-2 negative, 4-5 positive, 3 resolved by wording). Themes are keyword-tagged in English and Arabic, so a review can carry several themes. App Store coverage: deep crawl phase 1 of 2 complete, phase 2 running.

events.label: Update prompt that never clears
events.detail: 56 reviews in June and July 2018 mention an update prompt; several say the store offers no update and the app stops working.

events.label: The same update loop, a year later
events.detail: 502 reviews in June 2019, average 3.16. 120 mention an update; reviewers say it keeps asking to update after installing, even after a reinstall.

events.label: Best month on record
events.detail: Average 4.76 across 780 reviews, mostly version 3.7.0. 83% of that month's reviews are under 40 characters.

events.label: Face scan fails on a new phone
events.detail: 87 reviews since January 2023 mention the selfie or face check. The common story: it worked on the old phone, fails on the new one, and the daily attempt limit runs out.

events.label: Transaction approvals move to push notifications
events.detail: 17 reviews in 2025 mention notifications; the most upvoted dislikes a pop-up asking to enable them in place of SMS alerts, and others report approvals that never arrive on Android.

events.label: Recent months stay steady
events.detail: April 2026 averages 4.27 across 301 reviews and May 4.07 across 214; the negative themes are Crashes & errors (80), Login & access (64), App updates (52).

pains.title: Updates that loop or change the rules
pains.summary: The most common negative theme after crashes. Two generations of reviews describe an app that demands an update it cannot complete, and later ones a release that changed services without notice.

pains.title: OTPs and notifications that do not arrive
pains.summary: Login and payment approval depend on an OTP or a push message. Reviewers report OTPs that never arrive, a push-notification switch forced on them, and approvals that show only when the app is open.

quotes.body: One of the worst banking apps ive used. Freezes often, OTP sometimes doesnt arrive on phone and generally frustrating to use. Same as the adib website. AdIB needs to fire their IT team and get a team that can deliver a seamless digital banking experience. Update: still frustrating to use, keep having issues so have to uninstall and reinstall. How incompetent is their IT team??

I always receive SMS messages whenever I make a transaction. Recently, adib made a new service which includes receiving transaction details as a notification rather than SMS. So everyday I open the app, I get a stupid pop-up message asking me to enable the service (I don't want that. I want to receive sms messages), and there is no "don't show this message again" button to stop the pop-up notification. It is very frustrating and I hate it

wins.title: A calm, well-liked app for most customers
wins.summary: 72% of written reviews are five stars. The long ones call it easy, secure and quick, and say it saved a trip to the branch.

quotes.body: I rarely face any problems or delays. A great application, easy to use, great services and clear instructions and sections. It changed my life for the better.

Firstly I would like to tell this the best bank to have in the UAE greatly secured. The app you have all options on services you might need saving you time from making travels to the bank, and if any help is needed the bank will call you very fast or also very easy to reach them. For security if the bank suspects something wrong they don't hesitate to reach you out. GREATLY RECOMMEND.

Also the app is not working on android phones without a camera. My main office phone is without a camera and cannot access the app.

wins.title: Complaints that get resolved fast
